children: Idea Acquisition reported net income in the quarter, compared with a loss in the prior-year period, as $3.2M of interest income on Trust Account marketable securities outweighed $154,053 of operating costs. The company said it has not begun operations and does not expect operating revenue until after a business combination.
: Marketable securities totaled $357.9M at September 30, including approximately $7.9M of interest income.
: Cash outside the Trust Account was $1.1M at September 30; working capital was $751,793.
: The company expects to target software businesses leveraging large language models or other AI tools.
: Management said projected negative cash flows may leave insufficient liquidity for obligations within one year, raising substantial doubt.
